text:
alex_infra: Heads up — node pool gpu-east-3 has 3 cards flaky with recurring Xid 31. Autoscaler drained pods off those machines last night, but capacity hit for several jobs this morning.

maya_ops: saw the alerts. Are these the same serials from the 2024 batch? any vendor history?

alex_infra: quick list: S/N GFX-99421, GFX-99422, GFX-99430. Two show intermittent ECC single-bit followed by Xid bursts, one has thermal trip + soft ECC. Logs attached in case you want to grep.

sophie_sre: @alex_infra can you put the nodes into maintenance and mark as no-schedule? we should avoid reassigning heavy jobs until replacement arrives.

alex_infra: done — cordoned + drained. Left minimal infra tasks on healthy cards.

rma_bot: Ticket created: RMA-82341 for vendor 'GammaCompute'. Pickup SLA: 5 business days outbound. Shipping level: cross-dock to EU-WEST depot. Tracking pending.

maya_ops: That SLA is risky for our realtime customers. Any chance of expedited or handcarry?

ken_vendor: Hey team — I'm Ken from GammaCompute. RMA states depot swap by default. We can escalate to expedited courier for an extra charge; need PO approval and a statement of urgency. What's your preferred ETA?

alex_infra: We need replacement in <72h to avoid hitting our on-call burn. Is expedited 48h realistic? Also need return labels for the faulty serials.

ken_vendor: 48h is possible with paid expedite. I'll queue the request and share a quote. Can you confirm destination: EU-WEST1 crossdock (Address: EU-West DC3, Dock 7)? Also confirm customs paperwork required — are these company-owned or customer-dedicated assets?

maya_ops: Company-owned. Provide invoice + CN22 for customs. EU VAT paperwork is already on file with GammaCompute billing.

sophie_sre: Heads-up on routing — EU-WEST has had a backlog last week due to courier strike in NL. If we push expedite, route via DE hub (slower pickup but avoids backlog). Recommend adding a spare from local pool to cover the 48h if the vendor can't guarantee 48h.

alex_infra: Do we have spares? I looked earlier: eu-west spare pool shows 2 free cards, but one is reserved for a customer commit. We can temporarily reassign the other but cluster capacity will drop ~6% on peak.

maya_ops: Let's formalize a fallback: 1) Attempt expedited RMA 48h via GammaCompute (PO pending). 2) If vendor ETA >48h, allocate the single eu-west spare and spin up burst on dedicated capacity from eu-central for non-latency-critical jobs. 3) Keep faulty cards quarantined at DC and attach return manifest.

alex_infra: Agree. I'll create a PO for the expedite option and tag finance. Preparing manifest:
```
RETURN_MANIFEST:
- GFX-99421 -> RMA-82341
- GFX-99422 -> RMA-82341
- GFX-99430 -> RMA-82341
Carrier: GammaExpress
Pickup window: 09:00-17:00 (business days)
```

ken_vendor: Quote posted in vendor portal: expedite fee $1,200, ETA 48h w/ DE hub fallback 72h. I can mark pickup priority once PO number provided.

rma_bot: Update: RMA-82341 status changed to 'escalated' by ken_vendor at 2061240001.

maya_ops: @sophie_sre can you confirm whether we need to open a customs bond or special paperwork for the thermal-tripped unit? 

sophie_sre: No special bond. Just standard return + decontamination checkbox (electrical). Also flag as 'sensitive hardware' in the manifest to avoid automated automated screening delays.

alex_infra: FYI I'll also tag the serials into our asset tracker and mark 'awaiting return'. Once vendor picks up, share the tracking number and I'll schedule the inbound swap.

maya_ops: One more ask — if vendor route goes via DE hub, please ensure carrier adds 'overnight handoff' on the manifest; the extra leg adds customs scanning time.

ken_vendor: Understood. Will push overnight handoff. PO# needed to finalize.

alex_infra: PO submitted (PO-9082) and emailed to GammaCompute billing. Please confirm receipt.

ken_vendor: Received. Pickup scheduled for 2061243800. Courier: GammaExpress MSL-47. Tracking will post when manifest is scanned.

rma_bot: RMA-82341 update: pickup scheduled 2061243800, expected depot arrival 2061247400.

maya_ops: Great. After replacements arrive, we should run burn-in tests for 24h and then return cards to pool. Also add an automated check to flag repeated Xid 31 from same batch for 90 days.

sophie_sre: I'll add the monitoring rule and a runbook step for repeated Xid throttling alerts.

alex_infra: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up once tracking posted and after swap completed. :thumbsup:
